• Push-up bras give more lift and shape, with underwire and padded cups.
• Triangle bras feel lighter and softer, usually without underwire, for a more natural look.
• Cupless bras are the boldest option, with support from the band but an open-cup design.
• Panties are the easiest place to start if you want something wearable and less technical.
• Accessories are finishing pieces, like gloves or nipple covers, to style a look rather than build the base.

If you want the easiest first pick, a triangle bra or a set of panties is a great place to start.
